title: Vault112a Lounger #23 Placed-Reference and Persistent-Child Audit

gate.question: Can public raw Fallout3.esm-derived data resolve the exact Vault112a placed-reference graph around Lounger #23 and identify a James-specific persistent child, linked reference, storage object, session token, or carrier association?
gate.passed: Persistent-reference infrastructure is explicitly used by MQ04 objects, and Vault 112 architecture separates per-lounger input/processing endpoints from the shared Think Machine 3600r backend.
gate.open: The exact placed FormID of the local processor adjacent to Lounger #23 and any James-specific persistent child/storage/carrier reference were not resolved from the publicly indexed raw dumps reviewed.
gate.effect: The search frontier is narrowed to a direct xEdit/GECK reference-graph extraction of CELL Vault112a rather than further terminal-text inference.

mq04_failsafe_example.placement: GRUP Cell Persistent Children of TLAbandonedHouse
mq04_failsafe_example.significance: Shipped MQ04 data demonstrably uses persistent-child references for control-plane objects; persistent children are therefore a real mechanism, not a hypothetical GECK feature imported into the analysis.

geck_reference_rule.finding: Placed references have unique Reference IDs; Persistent Reference is required when a reference is addressed by scripts.
geck_reference_rule.significance: A true Lounger #23 backend child, if script-addressed, should be recoverable through the exact reference graph in Fallout3.esm/xEdit.

vault112_architecture.visiontron_rule: The lounger contains hardware for processing user input, while the simulation itself runs through the connected processing center.
vault112_architecture.per_lounger_layer: Vault 112 descriptions distinguish the central Think Machine from smaller computers associated with individual loungers for local processing/medical monitoring.

negative_controls.reason: The Dad status/stress pages are static NOTE records; MQ04DadPodScript exposes no memory/storage operation.
negative_controls.reason_2: MQ04PlayerContainerScript separately opens the player and Dad pod shell references and restores MQDadRef independently.
negative_controls.reason_3: The public location/terminal/script dumps reviewed do not expose a uniquely attributable placed Reference ID for the small computer adjacent specifically to Lounger #23.

save_james_effect.promotion_condition: Resolve a James-specific backend reference reachable from Lounger #23/local processor and show that the object participates in resident/session persistence, memory state, storage, restore, or carrier association.

next_gate.name: VAULT112A_DIRECT_XEDIT_CELL_REFERENCE_GRAPH_EXTRACTION
targets: Export CELL Vault112a with all temporary and persistent references from Fallout3.esm.
Locate MQ04DadPodShellRef, Vault112PodTermDad and the physical Lounger #23 furniture/base reference.
Enumerate nearby computer/terminal/activator/container references by coordinates and base object.
For each candidate local processor, resolve persistent flags, scripts, enable parent, ownership, linked refs, linked doors, containers and all script cross-references.
Search all references to the candidate local processor and to MQ04Doc/MQDadRef for session, storage, restore or carrier-side associations.
If one James-specific persistent backend object is found, create the PERSISTED_JAMES_STATE_CANDIDATE gate before making any whole-memory claim.
